travel.title: TRAVEL
travel.intro: San Juan Island is - well yes, you guessed it - an island! That means it's surrounded by water, so you will either arrive by boat or plane, unless you are an excellent swimmer.

modes.label: FIRST
modes.body: Most guests will fly into Seattle-Tacoma (SEA), then rent a car, carpool, or take a shuttle north to the ferry terminal in Anacortes. Paine Field (PAE) and Bellingham (BLI) are closer, but tend to have fewer flights—worth checking if they work for you!

modes.label: BY FERRY
modes.body: We highly recommend taking the ferry (and it's fun!). You can bring your car or park in Anacortes and walk on. If you’re bringing a car, reserve a spot both ways; walk-ons don’t need one.

modes.label: BY AIR
modes.body: Skip the drive and ferry with a flight from Seattle directly into Friday Harbor. Faster, more expensive and objectively very cool

modes.label: ON ISLAND
modes.body: Friday Harbor is very walkable, and we’ll provide transportation to and from the welcome dinner on Friday and wedding on Saturday. If you want to explore beyond town, bring a car.

travel.stayIntro: We will provide guests with transportation to and from the below locations, so it's highly recommended you stay at one of the following if you are not driving to the venue (ride-share crapshoot on the island).
travel.stayPhotoAlt: Open water off San Juan Island

stays.name: FRIDAY HARBOR HOUSE
stays.desc: If you're feeling fancy! This is the nicest of the three, right in town and great views of the harbor.

stays.name: ISLAND INN
stays.desc: Modern and low-key, with more of an apartment vibe vs. hotel.

stays.name: EARTHBOX INN
stays.desc: Casual and a little retro, with an indoor pool and spa!
